summary_en: FCSR commitment buyback post-adjustment completion: 2,393,266 shares finalized (down 251,500 from initial ToSTNeT-3 block of 2,644,800 shares on 2026-05-13). Average price ¥4,178.39 (99.634% × arithmetic mean of 2026-05-14 to 2026-07-01 VWAP). Adjustment method: reduction via warrant exercise allocation.
title_en: Notice of post-adjustment completion in commitment-type share repurchase (FCSR)
translation_en_brief: On 2 July 2026, Taiheiyo Cement announced completion of the post-adjustment phase of a commitment-type share repurchase (FCSR) programme previously disclosed on 12 May 2026. The final number of shares acquired following post-adjustment is 2,393,266. The post-adjustment mechanism worked as follows: Taiheiyo initially acquired 2,644,800 shares via ToSTNeT-3 on 13 May 2026 from Nomura Securities at a cumulative cost; the average acquisition price was then recalculated as ¥4,178.39 per share, computed as 99.634% of the arithmetic mean VWAP for the period 14 May to 1 July 2026. When dividing the initial purchase amount by this adjusted average price, the company derived a revised share count of 2,393,266 shares. The difference of 251,500 shares (reduction) was settled by allocation to warrant holders via exercise of share subscription rights.
